title: Yoko Ono wins custody battle for daughter Kyoko in St Thomas | 1971
content:
Yoko Ono won a custody battle for her eight-year-old daughter Kyoko on 24 September 1971.

The hearing took place on St Thomas in the Virgin Islands, where Lennon and Ono had testified during a custody hearing on 16 September.

The judge, Almeric Christian, awarded custody to Ono, subject to “the right of reasonable vistation of plaintiff, Anthony D Cox,” including summer and Christmas vacations in alternate years, but not within the same year, “and also to have such other and additional visitation with the child, upon reasonable notice, as may be mutually agreeable to the parties.”

However, this was not the end of the saga. Ono lost a second custody hearing on 29 September in Texas, where Cox and Kyoko were living.
